response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile web and full-stack engineer with some low-level and embedded exposure, but he does not meet several hard requirements for this role: there is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency, no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, and his C/UNIX experience is limited and dated. His career trajectory centers on web platforms (TypeScript/Node.js/DLang), not embedded LAN-switch firmware or network security technologies like MACsec, 802.1X, or switch-chip SDKs.
strengths: Broad, senior-level software engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded work
Low-latency systems experience with DLang, async I/O, and high-throughput microservices
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and demonstrated open-source and community contributions
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency, a hard requirement for the role
No Linux kernel source analysis/modification or embedded networking-security experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF)
C programming experience is limited and dated (brief C/C++ stint in 2014–2015); recent work is entirely web-focused

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking/security or Linux kernel experience
Strong general engineering seniority and systems programming aptitude
